name: framework-baseline
description: The framework's own tool policy, and the ceiling every emitted policy is measured against. Declared, not runtime-verified: authority for read-only is the RBAC grant Azure Resource Manager enforces (SEC-001, FR-51, FR-53).

denyRules.justification: v1 observes and never mutates. Denied here as well as absent from the allow list, so removing the allow list does not remove the prohibition.
No deletion, scaling or restart. An operation that cannot be undone must not be reachable from a layer that is defence in depth rather than the authority.
No command or query is constructed at run time. Only a reviewed, catalogued query runs, which is what keeps the surface reviewable by someone who did not write it.
No credential is read. Every sensitive value is an external reference resolved through the agent identity, never a value the agent retrieves and holds.
A single principal must not both propose and authorise. The approval ledger exists to record that separation, and a policy permitting self-approval would make the ledger decorative.
No finding leaves the environment. Publication is how an observation about a customer estate becomes a disclosure.
The agent does not create recurring work. A schedule it authored would outlive the execution that was reviewed, and nothing would be reviewing the runs that followed.
